taxonomy.name: Speech recognition and pronunciation
taxonomy.definition: Accuracy and usefulness of speaking exercises, mic scoring, accent coaching and pronunciation feedback, including strict, lenient or inconsistent grading.

taxonomy.name: Grammar teaching and explanations
taxonomy.definition: How well grammar rules are explained, whether tables, notes or references exist, and whether the lessons give clarity or leave rules unexplained.

taxonomy.name: Streaks, leagues and gamification
taxonomy.definition: Motivational effects and downsides of streaks, badges, XP, leagues, gems, reminders, goals and friend quests, including streak repair and pressure.

taxonomy.name: Live tutor sessions
taxonomy.definition: Quality, availability, booking, cancellation and reliability of live human tutors and their teaching style, feedback and recaps.

taxonomy.name: AI conversation practice
taxonomy.definition: Experience with the chatbot and roleplay scenarios: naturalness, memory, error correction, voice support, variety and low-pressure practice.

taxonomy.name: Language and course availability
taxonomy.definition: Range of languages offered, depth of individual courses, dialect options, and content differences by learner base language.

taxonomy.name: Lesson format and content quality
taxonomy.definition: Lesson length, structure, pacing, curriculum progression, exercise variety, repetition, and placement testing.

taxonomy.name: Progress and level tracking
taxonomy.definition: Accuracy and usefulness of progress dashboards, skill charts, level estimates, fluency scores, reports and vocabulary tracking.

taxonomy.name: Offline mode and device sync
taxonomy.definition: Offline downloads, syncing of progress across devices, platform and device compatibility, and feature differences between web and phone.

taxonomy.name: Pricing, billing and account issues
taxonomy.definition: Subscription cost and plans, renewals, refunds, cancellation, login and account management problems, and customer support.

taxonomy.name: Requests for review content
taxonomy.definition: Viewer suggestions and questions for the video creator about what to cover, test or show, or about the creator and the video's format and ads.
